name: zoo-ready
js: (async () => { const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < 60000) { const Z = window.CITY.highParkZoo; if (!Z || ['models', 'failed', 'off'].includes(Z.state)) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const Z = window.CITY.highParkZoo; return Z ? { state: Z.state, models: Z.models, failed: Z.failed, anim: Z.anim && { enabled: Z.anim.enabled, t: Z.anim.t, seed: Z.anim.seed } } : null; })()

name: ab-view
ab-warm-off
js: (() => { const Z = window.CITY.highParkZoo, Zs = Z.anim, prev = { steps: Zs.steps, ms: Zs.ms }; Zs.setEnabled(false); Zs.steps = 0; Zs.ms = 0; let mats = new Set(); window.__CITY_APP.scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isInstancedMesh && /^HighParkZooModel/.test(o.name) && o.visible) mats.add(o.material.name); }); return { arm: 'frozen', enabled: Zs.enabled, materials: [...mats], previousArm: { steps: prev.steps, msPerStep: prev.steps ? prev.ms / prev.steps : 0 } }; })()
